title: Vampirism No Sun Damage file
description: Exempts biomes, dimension types and dimensions from vampire sun damage. Loaded by de.teamlapen.vampirism.data.reloadlistener.SundamageReloadListener (RawFile#CODEC) from every data/<namespace>/vampirism/**/no_sun_damage.json; all packs stack.

replace.description: If true, clears the biome/dimension/no_damage entries collected so far before applying this file. `damage` entries are not cleared.

biomes.description: Biome ids or `#biome_tags` with no vampire sun damage.

dimensions.description: Dimension type ids or `#dimension_type_tags` with no vampire sun damage.

no_damage.description: Dimension (level) ids with no sun damage. Ids only, no tags.

damage.description: Dimension (level) ids that always have sun damage, overriding everything else. Ids only, no tags.

idOrTag.description: A namespaced id, or a tag reference prefixed with `#`.
